system.description:
Meles Traits

Characters with the meles heritage share a variety of traits with one another.

Age. Meles age and mature at a similar rate to humans.

Size. Meles are of a similar size to humans but slightly bulkier, averaging between 5–6 feet tall and weighing between 200–250 lbs. Your size is Medium.

Speed. Your base Speed is 30 feet.

Digger’s Claws. You gain a Burrow speed of 10 feet. You may use your burrowing speed to move through nonmagical sand, loose earth, loamy soil, mud, or snow, but not solid rock. You do not naturally leave any sort of tunnel behind but you can attempt to create a 5-foot by 5-foot wide tunnel in earth, soil, or snow by spending extra time and effort shoring it up and adding support. This reduces your burrowing speed to 5 feet every 15 minutes.

As an action, you may make an attack with your claws, and on a hit you deal 1d4 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (whichever is higher) slashing damage.

Mushroom, Mushroom. You have advantage on Nature checks made to identify which mushrooms are edible. When you successfully complete the Hunt and Gather journey activity, treat your success as a Critical Success instead.

Tunnel Vision. You gain darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

Meles Gifts

In addition to the traits found in your meles heritage, select one of the following gifts.

Steward of Death

You learn the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.omvngnmoo75is54f]{Spare the Dying} cantrip. At 3rd level you may cast the spell @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.it4gev1vr8gmecok]{False Life} once per long rest. At 5th level, you may cast @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.724qyfqw7qcpe1ol]{Gentle Repose} once per long rest. These spells do not count against the number of spells you know and do not require material components. Your spellcasting modifier for these spells is either Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, whichever is highest.

Uncommon Constitution

You have resistance to poison damage, and you gain an expertise die to saving throws made to resist the poisoned condition.

Warrior’s Fury

You gain proficiency with Intimidation, or an expertise die if you were already proficient.

Additionally, so long as you are bloodied, you are immune to the frightened condition.

Meles Paragon

When you reach 10th level, you become a better meles and gain one paragon gift from the following list.

Earth Shaker

The damage dealt by your @UUID[Compendium.out-of-the-wilds.features.Item.4DnH939qXxIImUAs]{Digger’s Claws} now counts as magical for the purposes of overcoming damage resistance.

Additionally, as an action, you may slam your fists into the ground, causing it to crack and erupt around you. Creatures within a 10-foot radius of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw versus your maneuver DC or be knocked [[/condition id=prone]]. This area becomes difficult terrain for all creatures other than you for a number of rounds equal to your Constitution modifier. You may use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

Martial Maven

You may wield and attack with two-handed melee weapons using only one hand. Damage dealt by weapons wielded in this fashion take a –2 penalty to damage rolls. If the creature is a Size category larger than you, that damage penalty is reduced to –1.

Patron of Death

You may cast the spell @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.9zhsri19dkhm9mcf]{Raise Dead} once per long rest without consuming a spell slot or requiring material components. Your spellcasting modifier for these spells is either Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, whichever is highest.
